B.title: B. Correct the Mistakes

C.title: C. Reading Comprehension
intro: Last month, Maya traveled to Vancouver for an international conference on renewable energy. She had been looking forward to the trip because she has been working on environmental projects for several years. Unfortunately, her journey did not begin well. The flight she was booked on was canceled because of bad weather, and the airline could not offer another flight until the following morning.

Maya was disappointed with the way the situation was handled. She felt the airline should have provided clearer information and accommodation for passengers who had been delayed overnight. She submitted a complaint online and was later offered a travel voucher.

By the time Maya arrived in Vancouver, the opening session had already finished. However, she attended the rest of the conference and met several experts in solar and wind energy. One speaker explained that although renewable energy systems can be expensive at first, costs have been falling thanks to improvements in technology.

After returning home, Maya gave her manager an update. She said the conference had been useful and suggested that her company invest more in energy-saving equipment. If the company had a larger environmental budget, she said, it could make several changes immediately.
questions: 1. Why had Maya been looking forward to the conference?
2. Why was her original flight canceled?
3. When could the airline offer her another flight?
4. What did Maya think the airline should have done?
5. What happened after she submitted a complaint?
6. What had happened by the time Maya arrived in Vancouver?
7. What kinds of energy did the experts discuss?
8. According to one speaker, why have renewable-energy costs been falling?
9. What did Maya suggest to her manager?
10. What could the company do if it had a larger environmental budget?

D.title: D. Listening & Summary
intro: Your teacher will read a passage aloud twice. Listen carefully, then write a summary in your own words. Include the main situation, the problem, how people reacted, and the final result or recommendation.

E.title: E. Writing Task
intro: Write about ONE of the following situations:
Option 1: Describe a problem you had with a product, hotel, airline, service, or purchase. Explain what happened, how you felt, what the company should have done, and how the problem was solved.
Option 2: Imagine you want to make an important change in your life, career, finances, or environment. Explain what you would change, why, and what you would do if you had the opportunity.
Use connected paragraphs and appropriate Level 4 grammar and vocabulary.
